About these 18 rides

Saturday is the big day: 8 of the 18 ride then. Starts run from 8:00 am to 7:00 pm. After work, 6 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 8 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 7. There are 3 rides made for women, trans and femme riders and 2 for families. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 18 and Nov 9, 2026.
